title: [BUG] `Context left until auto-compact` is hidden by default (`Auto-compact`=true) until toggle the `Auto-compact` (true -> false -> true)
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.43
- Operating System: linux, windows-terminal, v1.0.41 (win10 wsl ubuntu 24)
- Terminal:  modern windows terminal app

## Bug Description
`Context left until auto-compact` is hidden by default (`Auto-compact` is set to true).
It gets shown when toggle the `Auto-compact` (true -> false -> true).

## Steps to Reproduce
See `Bug Description`.

## Expected Behavior
If `Auto-compact` defaults to true, show `Context left until auto-compact` by default.

## Actual Behavior
See `Bug Description`.

<!-- Add any other context about the problem here, such as screenshots, logs, etc. -->
